questions.question: Name the eight points of the compass in clockwise order starting from north, and explain how you would work out the direction of Durban from Kimberley on a map.
questions.expected_answer: North, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west, north-west. Imagine standing at Kimberley, the place after the word from, facing north (using the north arrow), and decide which way you would turn to face Durban. Durban lies to the east of Kimberley.

questions.question: Explain the difference between latitude and longitude, naming the line of zero degrees for each.
questions.expected_answer: Latitude measures distance in degrees north or south of the equator, which is 0 degrees latitude; lines of latitude run east to west and are parallel. Longitude measures distance in degrees east or west of the Prime Meridian, which is 0 degrees longitude and passes through Greenwich in London; lines of longitude run from pole to pole and meet at the poles.

questions.question: Give the approximate position of Cape Town in degrees and say which two hemispheres it lies in. State two common errors when writing coordinates.
questions.expected_answer: About 34 degrees S, 18 degrees E. It lies in the Southern and Eastern Hemispheres. Common errors: writing longitude before latitude; leaving out the letters N, S, E or W; reading the value from the wrong edge of the map.
